Incoterms 2020

Calcul du Laytime

The computation of the total time allowed for loading and discharging a vessel as agreed in the charter party, with contractual consequences for exceeding or saving time (demurrage or dispatch).

Quick answer: The computation of the total time allowed for loading and discharging a vessel as agreed in the charter party, with contractual consequences for exceeding or saving time (demurrage or dispatch).

Questions and answers

What is Calcul du Laytime?

In this glossary, Calcul du Laytime refers to: The computation of the total time allowed for loading and discharging a vessel as agreed in the charter party, with contractual consequences for exceeding or saving time (demurrage or dispatch).

How is Calcul du Laytime used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Un calcul précis du laytime est essentiel pour éviter les frais de surestaries lors d'opérations retardées dans le transport de vrac."

Definition

The computation of the total time allowed for loading and discharging a vessel as agreed in the charter party, with contractual consequences for exceeding or saving time (demurrage or dispatch).

Operational example

Accurate laytime calculation is essential to avoid demurrage charges for delayed operations in bulk shipping.

Localized term
